reason: I already keep a spreadsheet and it works, so I would have to change how I do things before I see a benefit. The slip and statement features sound useful, but I would need to set up an iPhone Shortcut and trust a new app with my statements, and I would probably not bother once the free trial ends.
objection: The setup for the Shortcut and the upload of my card statement into a new app takes effort, and my spreadsheet already does the job for free.
would_change_my_mind: If during the free trial the slip capture saved me from retyping my weekly K PLUS and BBL transfers with almost no setup, and the statement import clearly sorted my categories correctly.
